title: Detainees report alleged uprising at ‘Alligator Alcatraz’: ‘A lot of people have bled’
summary: Reports of incident were denied by Florida and Ice officials as detainees say they were beat and teargas was fired Guards at Florida’s “Alligator Alcatraz” immigration jail deployed teargas and engaged in a mass beating of detainees to quell a mini-uprising, it was reported on Friday. The allegations, made by at least three detainees in phone calls to Miami’s Spanish language news channel Noticias 23 , come as authorities race to empty the camp in compliance with a judge’s order to close the remote tented camp in the Everglades wetlands. title: The Ethics of Immutability
summary: Bitcoin Magazine The Ethics of Immutability Bitcoin’s unalterable ledger is a technological mirror of the philosophical idea that our actions, once done, become part of the tapestry of history and of who we are: The concept of immutability calls us to an ethics of accountability as well. This post The Ethics of Immutability first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mark Stepheny .
